verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own docs state that browser agents can be deployed and run 'on a schedule or on demand', so recurring scheduled runs are a first-party capability. However, this rests on a single thin marketing-level line with no detail on configuring specific times or cron expressions, and no detail on how scraping jobs are scheduled. missing for 10: documentation of how to configure schedules (cron/time-of-day syntax, timezone handling), evidence that scraping jobs specifically can be scheduled, schedule management via API/SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
